bio: Set in 16 acres of Surrey countryside in Betchworth, Hartsfield Manor is the ideal base for exploring the array of local walks and must see attractions within the Surrey Hills, as well as the perfect setting to relax and enjoy a leisurely Afternoon Tea.  Enjoy a delicious selection of delectable mini cakes & pastries, finger sandwiches and of course scones with Cornish clotted cream and strawberry preserve. Go one step further by adding a bit of sparkle to your Afternoon Tea with a glass of Prosecco or Champagne.  Hartsfield Manor is situated in Betchworth, Surrey. Betworth station is 1.1 miles away, Reigate station within 3.2 miles and Dorking station is 3.6 miles away.
